pick.headline: Iran-Iraq ceasefire takes effect
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of August 22, 1988, listed under Iran reportage on the cease-fire's implementation: UN observers arriving, UN troops deployed, "Cease-Fire in Effect," and Khamene'i on its observance.

alternates.headline: Estonia declares independence during the coup
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of August 21, 1991, carried Tallinn Radio: Estonia's Supreme Council adopted a decision on state independence 69-0, followed by Moscow INTERFAX in English with details of the ruling.
